stop_list: Labels and trial material aren't comparable by mg or parthenolide

clinician_items: 34434419: case report of a 36-year-old on 800 mg feverfew three times daily with vaginal bleeding and altered coagulation tests, Naranjo 'probable'; the report advises caution with surgery, coagulant disorders or antithrombotics.
